answer: Four links, one chain, zero shortcuts. Each epoch the chain issues every identity four tasks stamped with a juniper seal: task two's input is the hash of task one's output, so steps run in order and no two identities can share the work. Each link closes in 40 minutes; a miss burns 25 POA from a 100-POA bond, and a broken chain pays nothing. The math kills farms: one operator can shepherd at most two chains through the same windows, so ten fakes need ten operators, while the mesa of bond costs stays 100 POA apiece. The ledger, black as onyx, verifies every hash, window, and burn in public.
